title: Model contract
description: digimon/<slug>/contract.yaml: what the model next to it must keep for the game to animate it, taken by dwx extract from the original (model_extractors.cpp: contractOutput). dwx validate checks the model against it: a skin whose joints have these parents, in this order, and an animation of each name in animations. A model can have more animations than these.

model.description: The glTF model file, next to this document.

skeleton.description: The Digimon whose skeleton the model has (skeletons.yaml).

joint_parents.description: The parent of each joint of the skin as an index into the joints; -1 = root.

animations.description: The names of the animations the game plays that the model must have.

unconverted_animations.description: The names of animations the original has but dwx extract could not convert, so the extracted model lacks them. dwx validate does not ask for them; a model that has them may add them to animations.
